subject: POC throughput window: request for short-term surge credits & insurance
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@finlytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term credits for overnight throughput validation
Attachments: finlytics_poc_testplan_v3.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the run-through yesterday. We completed a quick smoke run and want to execute a 36–48 hour throughput window next weekend to validate end-to-end latency at sustained QPS. Goal: 5k open connections, 200 RPS sustained across 3 endpoints, 95th p95 target < 220ms.

We need a short-term "insurance" provision — roughly enough credits to cover an estimated 160k tokens (prompt+response) plus headroom for bursts (~200k tokens total) OR an equivalent ephemeral quota on a dedicated test pool. This is timeboxed to Nov 20–21 (UTC).

Attached is our test plan (timings, ramp profile, and telemetry hooks). Can Redwood provision a provisional allowance and a quick signoff path so we can schedule the run? If you need a short MOU or credit agreement, happy to sign.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform Engineering, FinLytics
alex@finlytics.com | +1 415-555-0198

--

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: Alex Rivera <alex@finlytics.com>, Priya Shah <priya@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: short-term credits for overnight throughput validation

Marissa / Jonas — looping you both in for approval. FinLytics wants a 36–48h throughput window (target dates Nov 20–21 UTC) to validate latency at ~200 RPS sustained (spikey bursts to 500 RPS). Their attached plan estimates ~200k token-equivalent consumption.

Proposed internal approach:
- Offer a provisional promo allowance: 200k tokens (ephemeral) OR ability to route their test traffic to a dedicated preprod pool for the window.
- Require a one-paragraph mutual action note: dates, expected traffic profile, and a commitment to not use the window for production traffic.
- CS/Billing to monitor burn and cut the window if error/abuse signals appear.

Marissa — can we greenlight a 200k token promo here (no billing commit) and attach a short approval PDF for the customer? If we need a spend cap instead, suggest $4,000 spend cap for the window.

Alex — if that works, please confirm the exact UTC window you'd like and sign the DocuSign MOU when I send. I can also stand up a temporary Slack channel for real-time telemetry coordination.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Attachments: promo_approval_finsurge_20261116.pdf (application/pdf)

Karthik / Jonas — Approved conditionally.

Quick notes:
- Approve a one-time promotional allowance equal to either 200k tokens or $4,000 cap for the Nov 20 00:00 UTC → Nov 22 00:00 UTC window (we're giving an extra 24h buffer).
- This is a provisional credit — non-renewing and subject to our acceptable use policy.
- Require FinLytics to acknowledge the traffic profile and that this is test traffic only.

I attached a short approval stub for our records — please attach to the HubSpot deal and send to the customer. Jonas, please coordinate with Ops to pin a preprod pool (if they prefer routing to our pool instead of token promo).

Marissa Cole
